data.narrative:
Biofire, a Series A-stage company in Defense & Security founded by Kai Kloepfer, has raised $52.9M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 10 private companies and 2 public peers (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS), including same-stage, same-sector comparables: Stark Defence ($4.0B), Singularity ($400M), and NODA AI ($125M).

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total raised as a proxy for post-money value, applies a 2.0x multiplier typical for Series A progression to the $53M base, implying a $106M valuation. Peer-median analysis across the 3 same-sector, same-stage comparables yields a median valuation of $400M, with a range spanning $125M to $4.0B. The wide peer range reflects material heterogeneity within the Defense & Security cohort at Series A.

Triangulating both methods produces a valuation range of $90M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $253M. The divergence between stage-progression ($106M) and peer-median ($400M) reflects uncertainty in whether Biofire's capital efficiency and market positioning align with the lower or upper quartile of Defense & Security Series A valuations. Key uncertainties include the sustainability of the peer comp set given the 32x spread between min and max comparable valuations, and whether Biofire's specific technology and traction justify positioning within that range.
